{{Quote|I think it is time we reacquaint the young senator with his mother. Kill him!|Count Dooku speaking to this droid and a fellow one.|<ref name="A Friend in Need" />}}
This '''BX-series droid commando''' served in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid]] along with a fellow one were stationed in the [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|Royal Palace]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

==Biography==
During the conference between the Separatist and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] delegations regarding the legitimation of the Separatists' government, held in the throne room of Duchess [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], junior [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] entered the room and, with the Duchess' permission, delivered an embittered accusation against [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] for his involvement in the murder of [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|his mother]].

The Separatist attendants then ordered this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and a fellow one to take Lux to the vessel which brought the Separatist delegation to Mandalore and was then put before the holographic projection of Count Dooku, who denied any involvement in Mina's death. The Count then ordered the droids to execute Lux, but he was saved by [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who had followed him to the vessel and took out the droids.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />
